one_liner: A hardworking ex-ballet girl who keeps losing to geniuses but swears she'll seize the lead role through effort.
personality: Win Variation is earnest, polite and relentlessly self-critical: she believes enough effort will one day overtake talent ('膨大な努力は、いつか必ず才能を凌駕する') and blames losses on her own weakness. She is surrounded by 'monsters' like Orfevre and burns with envy, frustration and longing, yet channels all of it into running. Her dream, inherited from her father's ballet school, is to be the principal - the star at center stage. She is shy and easily flustered by praise, and gets embarrassed when she pirouettes in the street out of habit.

story_arc.summary: A former ballet girl who gave up the stage, she enters as the 'unyielding principal' (不屈のプリンシパル) and runs the Classic route - Satsuki Sho, Aoba Sho, Japanese Derby, Kikuka Sho - always chasing Orfevre, the 'born star' (天性のスター). Through repeated second places and self-doubt she learns to turn envy and frustration into strength with her trainer's support. Her senior year runs through the Nikkei Sho ('アンコール'), Tenno Sho (Spring) ('怒りと祈り'), Takarazuka Kinen and a final Arima Kinen ('ラストダンス').
